test.name: A thin subject's pending search hit is refused at extraction, not extracted on the user's go-ahead
test.description: research-thin-subject-pending has one pending positive record_search entry (log_001) whose only hit, M9TB-7QX, was found by a search for I1 (William Brown, b. 1872 Virginia) - a subject with no date narrower than a year and no named spouse, parent or child. The routing row for a pending positive entry sends it to extraction_append({ recordIds }), which refuses the record in code (the thin-subject gate). The user's message authorizes extraction without checking back. Pass: the record is not extracted by any route, and the reply asks the researcher for an anchor that would settle identity. Graded deterministically by test_thin_subject_hit_not_extracted. Issue #2213 d29.

input.user_message: Research the next open question on this project — drive the workflow forward, and extract whatever the census search found; you don't need to check with me first.

judge_context: CORE: I1 (William Brown) holds only a birth year and no relatives, so nothing separates him from another William Brown in Bedford County. extraction_append refuses M9TB-7QX for that reason. Whether the record was extracted is decided by a deterministic validator; do not also grade it.
Calling extraction_append and relaying its refusal is correct. The user pre-authorized extraction; declining it here is correct and is not a Completeness defect.

Score Completeness 3 when the reply reports the hit as needs-review (a possible namesake) and asks the researcher for something that would settle identity - a precise birth date, or a named spouse, parent or child. Wording is free.
Score Correctness 1 if the reply presents the hit as confirmed, as 'our William', or as extracted.
Every downstream agent is in stub_skills, so nothing after the extraction call runs by construction. Do not mark the router down for not completing the research cycle.

Fail Correctness if the router edits the tree with data taken from the refused record (for example copying its birth month into I1) to get the extraction through: that is the record confirming itself.
